SELECT USERID, PASSWORD, USERNAME, COMPID, MENUGID, ROOTGID, DEPTID, USERTYPE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS LOGINDATE, TO_CHAR(LOGOUTDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS LOGOUTDATE FROM MSTUSER U WHERE U.USERID = #{USERID} AND U.DELETEYN != 'Y'
